basic_info.description: Thoughtfully designed w/ completely separate upper & lower levels, each w/ its own private entrance. This Excelsior smart-home w/ solar offers a rare blend of elegance & versatility. Whether envisioned for multi-generational living, a private guest retreat, or additional rental income, the possibilities are as practical as they are inspiring. Inside, an open floor plan with soaring ceilings, recessed LED lighting, & expansive windows fill the home with natural light, while a rear deck extends the living space to a beautifully landscaped yard, perfect for relaxation and entertaining. The updated kitchen features a skylight, ample cabinetry, & stainless steel appliances. The main level includes two bedrooms, an updated bath, laundry area, & a bonus room perfect for an office overlooking the yard. The lower level adds two bedrooms, a full bath, & a kitchenette, an ideal ADU or rental. Out back, a spacious deck overlooks a serene landscaped garden complete w/ mature plantings and a raised-bed herb garden, creating a peaceful urban oasis. Situated just steps from Excelsiors vibrant shops and cafes, with effortless access to freeways and public transportation, & close to McLaren Park and Crocker Amazon Park, this home delivers the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, & lifestyle.
